name: Basic Component Diagram
description: Create a C3 diagram showing components within a container and their interactions
helpContent: Generate a C3 (Component) diagram decomposing a container into logical components. Show responsibilities and dependencies between components within the same container.
template:
Create a C3 Component diagram for [Service Name] showing:
1. Components: [List internal components/modules]
2. Responsibilities: [Brief description of each component]
3. Dependencies: [Which components interact and how]
4. External Services: [APIs called, databases accessed]

Show synchronous/asynchronous communication patterns.

name: Layered Architecture Components
description: C3 diagram showing presentation, business logic, and persistence layers
helpContent: Design component-level diagrams for layered architectures. Show how components in different layers (presentation, business logic, persistence) interact.
template:
Generate a C3 diagram with layered components:
1. Presentation Layer: [UI components, controllers]
2. Business Logic Layer: [Services, handlers]
3. Persistence Layer: [Repositories, DAOs]
4. External Integrations: [APIs, external services]

Show layer-to-layer communication and external dependencies.
